## Design

### 2026-10-11 – Hi there,

**7h**

Hi there,
It may have taken me my whole weekend but I finished everything.

I decided to make my starbie more rabbit looking.
This was my first hardware project so I am extremely proud of it.

The guide was right, there are some excellent youtube videos on Kikad, which helped me alot. (including me realising that labels and text are not the same thing 🤦‍♂️)

I did rush this a bit as I had no time during the week, but I still think it looks cool.

Thanks for this opportunity,
Joel
